items.title: How climate change and food insecurity could fuel future conflicts
items.description: Climate change, conflict, and trade tensions are putting pressure on the global food system. New research suggests the biggest risk is not food shortages, but whether societies can peacefully adapt to change.

items.description: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?

items.title: How might Lindsay Clancy’s case have unfolded in another country?
items.description: The US mother was on trial for strangling her three children. In other western countries, there’s a specific law for mums who kill their young children.

items.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Far-right AfD eyes power in German state vote
items.description: Although the eastern state accounts for less than 3% of the nationwide electorate, the election outcome could serve as a bellwether about the far-right AfD's prospects in the rest of the country. DW has the latest.

items.title: Nepal bet nearly everything on hydropower - the floods show why that's a problem
items.description: More than 10% of Nepal's energy generation capacity was knocked out by last week's floods.

items.title: German company successfully launches rocket to space
items.description: Bavaria-based Isar Aerospace managed to launch its Spectrum rocket into orbit, 18 months after its first attempt. This is the first such launch from European soil.

items.title: US envoys set for Ukraine talks after meeting Putin in Russia
items.description: It will be the first trip by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Trump's top negotiators, to Kyiv.
